channel.title: Consola Abierta — English edition
channel.description: Systems engineering, infrastructure and technical operations explained from the inside.

item.title: How an LLM Learns: Next-Token Prediction, Cross Entropy, Backpropagation and AdamW
item.description: Autoregressive objective, Cross Entropy, gradients and AdamW. CPU-reproduced lab with two learning-rate policies and twelve checks.

item.title: Self-Attention Deep Dive: mathematics, gradients and modern variants
item.description: Q/K/V derivation, gradients, causal masking, MHA/GQA/MQA and RoPE. CPU-reproduced PyTorch lab with seven numerical checks.

item.title: Inside a Transformer: from tokens to a decoder-only LLM
item.description: A deep dive into embeddings, Q/K/V, scaled dot-product attention, causal masking, Pre-LayerNorm and next-token prediction. Includes a reproduced TinyGPT PyTorch lab.

item.title: SQL Server tempdb: diagnosing log growth caused by an open transaction
item.description: Reproduced SQL Server 2022 lab: ACTIVE_TRANSACTION, 26 log growth events, DMV diagnosis and rollback validation.

item.title: Windows Server under pressure: advanced CPU, memory, storage and network diagnostics
item.description: A reproducible Windows Server 2025 investigation covering CPU, memory, DiskSpd, ETW and guest-to-guest TCP with dedicated PerfMon sampling and documented limits.
